div.div: One Terraform root, test/terraform/lab/services, creates the Docker services under one owner. The Go harness, not Terraform, starts the infraweave servers, launchers and worker controllers as host processes. Every container publishes only to a random 127.0.0.1 port. The kubernetes batch adds k3s, whose run Pods reach the servers through the scenario's HTTPS front.

text.tspan: One Terraform root, test/terraform/lab/services, creates the Docker services under one owner. The Go harness, not Terraform, starts the infraweave servers, launchers and worker controllers as host processes. Every container publishes only to a random 127.0.0.1 port. The kubernetes batch adds k3s, whose run Pods reach the
servers through the scenario's HTTPS front.
